summary: Block advisory plan deletions unsupported by the closed remediation DSL

delivery.outcome: Emit blocking T2C_UNAUTHORIZED_DELETION for every relevant file-delete proposal because closed remediation-intent v1 contains no typed deletion operation. Preserve advisory-only analysis, valid modify plans and isolation from unrelated historical plans; publish immutable standard 0.20.65.
nonGoals: Add a deletion operation or invented producer actionRef field
Grant execution, deletion or publication authority
Mutate target incident artifacts or foreign work

architecture.decision: Risk level and EXPLICIT_HUMAN metadata characterize an existing action but do not define a deletion operation. All relevant producer file-delete changes therefore produce a blocking advisory finding under the current closed DSL. Keep existing projection filtering and supported modification behavior. Validate schema-shaped complete synthetic producer plans without a runtime dependency on another repository.
interfaceChanges: Run remediation plan safety regressions in existing Linux and Windows CI jobs.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Schema-valid read-only synthetic producer plan exposes an accepted deletion despite IMPLEMENT-only intent; tests reject delete with or without destructive metadata, accept modify, filter unrelated history, and retain ADVISORY authority and input digests.
Existing remediation integration, parity, native gate and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and immutable standard v0.20.65 release are verified.
